candidates.excerpt: The Enforcement Directorate has summoned YSRC MP Y.S. Avinash Reddy for questioning on October 14 in its money-laundering probe linked to the Vivekananda Reddy murder case.

candidates.excerpt: Pargat Singh has been appointed Punjab Congress chief ahead of the Assembly elections, replacing Amarinder Singh Raja Warring, who resigned from the post. The change comes amid infighting in the state unit.

candidates.excerpt: PepsiCo and Monster Energy have sued the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India over its directive against the use of ‘energy drink’ in labels. The companies said the restriction would have ‘grave commercial consequences’ and hurt ‘substantial investments’.

candidates.title: Man dies in road accident 10 days after son’s birth in Medak district
candidates.excerpt: Two residents of Kadhaluru village were killed after a JCB allegedly hit their motorcycle in Papannapet mandal of Sangareddy district on Thursday night. One of the deceased had become a father just 10 days ago, while the other was unmarried.

candidates.title: Pargat Singh replaces Warring as Punjab Congress chief: Who he is and why Congress chose him
candidates.excerpt: Pargat Singh has been chosen as the new president of the Punjab Pradesh Congress Committee. He replaces Amrinder Singh Raja Warring, who resigned amid party factional tensions. With the 2027 assembly elections approaching, Congress seeks to unify its internal divisions. Singh’s political experience as an MLA and former minister provides valuable legislative insights. His association with sports also aims to engage a younger voter base effectively.
